As Ericsson (ERIC) Share Price Declined, Ulysses Management Lifted by $900,000 Its Position; Apple (AAPL) Stock Price Declined While Union Bankshares Boosted Position
May 26, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Joshua Nash increased its stake in Ericsson (ERIC) by 9.38% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ulysses Management Llc bought 150,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.22% with the market. The hedge fund run by Joshua Nash held 1.75M shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.69M, up from 1.60 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ulysses Management Llc who had been investing in Ericsson for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $24.23B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.54% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $7.42. About 2.07 million shares traded. Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson (NASDAQ:ERIC) has declined 4.93% since May 26, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 16.48% the S&P500.
Union Bankshares Corp increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 8.47% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Union Bankshares Corp bought 4,201 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 53,784 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.10 million, up from 49,583 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Union Bankshares Corp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $926.90B market cap company. The stock increased 0.23% or $0.43 during the last trading session, reaching $188.58. About 15.45 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Among 20 analysts covering Ericsson ( NASDAQ:ERIC ), 4 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 12 Hold. Therefore 20% are positive. Ericsson had 43 analyst reports since August 5, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson (NASDAQ:publ) has “Neutral” rating given on Tuesday, October 25 by JP Morgan. The stock of Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson (NASDAQ:publ) has “Neutral” rating given on Tuesday, June 21 by Goldman Sachs. On Tuesday, May 3 the stock rating was downgraded by Swedbank to “Neutral”. The firm has “Hold” rating by Canaccord Genuity given on Thursday, September 21. The rating was upgraded by Cowen & Co to “Market Perform” on Friday, April 20. As per Monday, February 5, the company rating was downgraded by Bank of America. Charter Equity downgraded the shares of ERIC in report on Wednesday, July 20 to “Mkt Underperform” rating. The company was initiated on Friday, March 11 by Wells Fargo. RBC Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Outperform” rating in Wednesday, November 11 report. The stock of Telefonaktiebolaget LM Ericsson (NASDAQ:publ) earned “Hold” rating by J.P. Morgan on Tuesday, July 18.
Ulysses Management Llc, which manages about $1.47 billion and $940.35 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Triumph Bancorp Inc by 75,000 shares to 90,000 shares, valued at $2.84M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Bristol (NYSE:BMY) by 30,000 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 20,000 shares, and cut its stake in Macerich Co (NYSE:MAC).
